blocked.name: Arthur, Marigold Knight
blocked.why: 'Whenever Arthur and at least one other creature attack': no trigger for this creature being declared in a declaration of two or more attackers. A `controls attacking >= 2` intervening-if would be rechecked as it resolves, which the printed trigger isn't.

blocked.name: Jacked Rabbit
blocked.why: Ravenous's draw is an intervening-if on X (rule 702.156a: 'if X is 5 or more'). A trigger's `condition` goes through the static evaluator, which answers the `x` kind false, so it would never trigger; a `conditional` in the effect would put a do-nothing trigger on the stack whenever X < 5.

blocked.name: Skyclave Apparition
blocked.why: The leaves ability reads 'the exiled card' (its owner and mana value) of a permanent exile: no amount or player ref reaches a card a source exiled for good.

blocked.name: Dusk // Dawn
blocked.why: Split cards are built, aftermath isn't: Dawn must be castable only from the graveyard and exiled however it leaves the stack (rule 702.127).

blocked.name: Fortune Teller's Talent
blocked.why: A Class (levels as sorcery-speed activated abilities, abilities gained per level) isn't modeled (AUTHORING §15); level 1 also needs 'look at the top card of your library any time'.

blocked.name: Shield Broker
blocked.why: No shield counter (prevent damage / replace destruction by removing one, rule 122.1c), and no control duration 'for as long as it has a shield counter on it'.

blocked.name: Stolen by the Fae
blocked.why: 'Target creature with mana value X': a spell's target filter can't read its own X (AUTHORING §6 — only an activated ability is offered per X); casting at X=2 at a 2-drop is refused as having no legal target.

blocked.name: Echoing Assault
blocked.why: 'Target nontoken creature that's attacking that player': no filter clause or target spec for the player (or planeswalker controller) an attacker is attacking.

blocked.name: Combat Celebrant
blocked.why: Exert as it attacks (an optional choice at declaration, with 'won't untap during your next untap step') and a 'when you do' trigger.

blocked.name: Inferno Titan
blocked.why: '3 damage divided as you choose among one, two, or three targets' on a triggered ability: division is built for spells only (AUTHORING §15).

blocked.name: Helm of the Host
blocked.why: `create-token-copy.of` can't name the equipped creature; and 'that token gains haste' isn't copiable (ruling), while `gainsHaste` is a copy exception that copies of the token inherit.

blocked.name: Rowdy Research
blocked.why: '{1} less for each creature that attacked this turn': no cost-reduction amount counts attackers this turn, including ones no longer on the battlefield (the `attacked` turn stat is only 0/1).

blocked.name: Junk Winder
blocked.why: 'It doesn't untap during its controller's next untap step'. (Affinity for tokens itself is expressible as a `countOf` self cost reduction.)

blocked.name: Tetsuko Umezawa, Fugitive
blocked.why: A static affecting 'creatures you control with power or toughness 1 or less': an affects filter can't read P/T inside the layer fold (AUTHORING §15).
